name: @red-cup-engineering/replay-spectacle
description: Ashlar Fabrication's render family: turns a verified game replay into one self-contained HTML page (no server, no CDN) via TUFTE. Domain-neutral rendering lives in TUFTE; this package is the adapter that supplies the game vocabulary TUFTE's own README says must live outside it.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.mjs adapters/*.mjs adapters/vendor/ruinfold/engine/*.mts adapters/vendor/crucible/*.mts scripts/*.mjs test/*.test.mjs scripts/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
